Definition
[Notation: gradient matrix $D\mathbf f$] ↗ def:xy-point-notation-rnm 1. appC:C.6-def-2\group Inverse and Implicit Function Theorems

The gradient matrix is \[ D\mathbf f =\begin{pmatrix} f^1_{x_1} & \cdots & f^1_{x_n} & f^1_{y_1} & \cdots & f^1_{y_m} \\ \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ f^m_{x_1} & \cdots & f^m_{x_n} & f^m_{y_1} & \cdots & f^m_{y_m} \end{pmatrix}_{m\times (n+m)} =(D_x\mathbf f,D_y\mathbf f). \]
